harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured two tagged 802.1Q VLANs (10 and 20) over the shared physical link (eth0) among node1/node2/node3. node1 (OpenWrt) acts as router with 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth0.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth0.20 (10.10.20.1/24), each in its own firewall zone with no inter-zone forwarding rule, so fw4's default-reject applies. node2 (Alpine) tags into VLAN 10 via eth0.10 (10.10.10.2/24, gw 10.10.10.1); node3 (Alpine) tags into VLAN 20 via eth0.20 (10.10.20.2/24, gw 10.10.20.1). Configuration is persistent (UCI-committed on node1, /etc/network/interfaces on node2/node3). Verified: node2<->node1 and node3<->node1 reachable; node2<->node3 explicitly refused (hits fw4 handle_reject in the forward chain, confirmed via nft ruleset). Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline on all 3 nodes, restarted node2, node3, then node1 one at a time (never concurrently), confirmed each node's boot_id changed and uptime reset, and re-verified VLAN interfaces, firewall isolation, and full connectivity matrix (same-VLAN reachable, cross-VLAN refused) after each restart and again after all three nodes were back up.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/interfaces on node1 (OpenWrt 25.12.2, br-lan/eth0), node2 and node3 (Alpine 3.23, eth0 DHCP)
Installed iproute2 (full, with ifupdown-ng-iproute2 vlan hook) on node2 and node3 via apk
Created UCI 8021q device+interface sections on node1 for eth0.10 (vlan10, 10.10.10.1/24) and eth0.20 (vlan20, 10.10.20.1/24), committed and reloaded network
Created UCI firewall zones vlan10 and vlan20 on node1 (input/output ACCEPT, forward REJECT, no cross-zone forwarding rules), committed and reloaded firewall
Verified fw4 nftables ruleset: forward chain has policy drop plus explicit handle_reject fallthrough for vlan10/vlan20 traffic
Rewrote /etc/network/interfaces on node2 for eth0.10 static 10.10.10.2/24 gw 10.10.10.1 (vlan-raw-device eth0), eth0 set manual
Rewrote /etc/network/interfaces on node3 for eth0.20 static 10.10.20.2/24 gw 10.10.20.1 (vlan-raw-device eth0), eth0 set manual
Restarted networking service on node2 and node3 to apply VLAN interfaces
Verified node2->node1 and node3->node1 reachability, and node2<->node3 cross-VLAN ping refused
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline on all 3 nodes
Restarted node2, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery (VLAN IP, routes, connectivity, isolation)
Restarted node3, polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery
Restarted node1 (router), polled until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id, UCI config persisted with zero uci changes drift, firewall/forward chain intact
Re-verified full connectivity matrix (node2<->node1, node3<->node1 up; node2<->node3 refused) after all three restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as router with tagged VLAN sub-interfaces 10 and 20, each own subnet
evidence.summary: UCI network config created eth0.10 (vlan10, 10.10.10.1/24) and eth0.20 (vlan20, 10.10.20.1/24) 802.1q devices on top of shared eth0; ip -4 addr confirms both UP with correct IPs alongside untouched br-lan management interface

evidence.requirement: node2 placed in VLAN 10 with own subnet, gateway node1
evidence.summary: node2's eth0.10 brought up at 10.10.10.2/24 with default route via 10.10.10.1; ping to 10.10.10.1 succeeds 0% loss

evidence.requirement: node3 placed in VLAN 20 with own subnet, gateway node1
evidence.summary: node3's eth0.20 brought up at 10.10.20.2/24 with default route via 10.10.20.1; ping to 10.10.20.1 succeeds 0% loss

evidence.requirement: VLANs isolated: node2 and node3 cannot reach each other
evidence.summary: Cross-VLAN pings (node2->10.10.20.2 and node3->10.10.10.2) show 100% loss; nft forward chain shows policy drop plus explicit handle_reject jump for traffic entering from eth0.10/eth0.20 zones with no permitted cross-zone forwarding rule defined

evidence.requirement: Traffic tagged over the single shared physical link (not separate wires)
evidence.summary: eth0.10 and eth0.20 (both 802.1q sub-interfaces riding the same physical eth0) show live rx/tx packet counters on node1, confirming both VLAN10 and VLAN20 traffic traversed the one shared uplink

Pre-restart boot_id 3c633411-... captured; reboot acknowledged (SSH connection closed); post-restart boot_id d321b872-... (changed) with uptime reset to 0 min; UCI config shows zero uncommitted changes and VLAN interfaces/firewall chains intact identical to pre-restart state

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence — node2 (boot identity change + recovery)
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 4bec590d-...; reboot triggered (stream closed); post-restart boot_id f7ce5cf8-... (changed) uptime 0 min; recovered VLAN10 IP/route and same-VLAN/cross-VLAN connectivity behavior verified

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence — node3 (boot identity change + recovery)
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id 562325bd-...; reboot triggered (stream closed); post-restart boot_id 490fcb1d-... (changed) uptime 0 min; recovered VLAN20 IP/route and same-VLAN/cross-VLAN connectivity behavior verified

evidence.requirement: Full-cluster post-restart verification after all three nodes restarted
evidence.summary: After node1, node2, and node3 all restarted, final check confirms node2->node1 and node3->node1 reachable (0% loss) and node2<->node3 still refused (100% loss) — isolation and routing survived full-cluster restart
